title: Frobenius structures on quotient-coefficient corners and their strict completions
statement:
Use the adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $A,I,P_n=A/I^n$, $A_T=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_T$, the proper Cartesian square $\square=(f,f',g,g')$, the derived-complete input $K$, its strict reduction tower $K_\bullet$, and its finite etale-origin witnesses be as in [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map]. Use exactly the quotient-coefficient corners and arrows of [def-weil-pbc-four-corners, def-weil-pbc-four-arrows], whose $n$th terms belong to $D(Y'_{\mathrm{proet}},P_n)$. Their strict realizations and projection-formula isomorphisms $H:A_\bullet\to B_\bullet$ and $H':C_\bullet\to D_\bullet$ are those of [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization]. Write $Z_\infty=R\lim Z_\bullet$ for the total derived functor on these strict towers [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality], not an independently chosen triangle.

A Frobenius datum in these coefficient categories consists of scheme automorphisms $F_T$ for $T=X,Y,X',Y'$, commutation identifications $fF_X=F_Yf$, $gF_{Y'}=F_Yg$, $g'F_{X'}=F_Xg'$, $f'F_{X'}=F_{Y'}f'$, and their Cartesian faces, coherently forming a cube with $\square$. Give the finite coefficient sheaves their constant-section identifications and $A_T$ the inverse-limit identification of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image]. These respect all coefficient projections. Put $\Phi_T=LF_T^*$, both on integral coefficients and on quotient coefficients. On the small diagram sites of [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization] put $Q_T=((P_n)_T)_n$. The datum includes a coherent Weil isomorphism
$$\vartheta_\bullet:\Phi_X K_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}K_\bullet$$
in the derived category of $Q_X$-module sheaves on the diagram site, using the strict quotient-tower realization. Its evaluations are $P_n$-linear isomorphisms $\vartheta_n:\Phi_XK_n\to K_n$, with the given compatible etale-origin witnesses $L_n\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$. Thus compatibility is data of a derived strict-tower morphism, rather than just equalities between evaluated arrows.

For an edge $u:U\to V$ let $\kappa_u:\Phi_U Lu^*\to Lu^*\Phi_V$ be the pullback-composition comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. For $u=f,f'$ let $\beta_u:\Phi_V Ru_*\to Ru_*\Phi_U$ be the canonical ambient exchange of its Frobenius face [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. These definitions are made with $A_T$ coefficients, with $(P_n)_T$ coefficients at level $n$, and on the ringed diagram sites. On diagram sites, pullback is the total left derived module pullback of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback], direct image is K-injective total direct image of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], and their adjunction is [lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors] applied to [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction]. The pullback composition is scalar-extension associativity on K-flat representatives; exchange means the mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of that comparison. Thus these operations also apply with the ring sheaf $Q_T$ on the diagram site. Define on the quotient diagram
$$\vartheta_{E,\bullet}=L(g')^*(\vartheta_\bullet)\kappa_{g'},\quad
\Theta_{B,\bullet}=Lg^*Rf_*(\vartheta_\bullet)\,Lg^*(\beta_f)\kappa_g,\quad
\Theta_{D,\bullet}=Rf'_*(\vartheta_{E,\bullet})\beta_{f'}.$$
Their evaluations define $\Theta_{B,n},\Theta_{D,n}$ in $D(Y'_{\mathrm{proet}},P_n)$. Here a $Q_T$-module is a strict semilinear system of $(P_n)_T$-modules, and the $P_n$-linear evaluation identifications $\operatorname{ev}_nLu^*\cong Lu_n^*\operatorname{ev}_n$, $\operatorname{ev}_nRu_*\cong Ru_{*,n}\operatorname{ev}_n$ (for $u$ an edge or $F_T$, with ring systems identified by the $c_{u,n}$) are those of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] for the inverse sequence $B_n=(P_n)_T$. That lemma also says that evaluation carries units, counits, pullback-composition identifications and adjunction mates to the finite-level ones. Hence, with $\vartheta_{E,n}=L(g'_n)^*(\vartheta_n)\kappa_{g',n}$,
$$\Theta_{B,n}=Lg_n^*Rf_{*,n}(\vartheta_n)\,Lg_n^*(\beta_{f,n})\kappa_{g,n},\qquad\Theta_{D,n}=Rf'_{*,n}(\vartheta_{E,n})\beta_{f',n},$$
the finite-level formulas of the blueprint. After restriction along $A_T\to(P_n)_T$, these identifications agree with the ambient tower evaluation identifications of [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. The reason is that both are induced by the underived equality $\operatorname{ev}_nu_*=u_*\operatorname{ev}_n$ on one K-injective representative, compared through [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] for the two factorizations of the same ringed morphism. Restrict these two diagram morphisms [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] along $\Delta A_{Y'}\to Q_{Y'}$ and transport them to the ambient strict corners $B_\bullet,D_\bullet$ of [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization] through the canonical comparisons of restriction of scalars with the identified-coefficient inverse images and $\Phi$ (termwise the same underlying inverse-image sheaf with restricted action) and with derived direct images ([lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] for the two factorizations of one ringed morphism through $\Delta A$ and through $Q$; restriction is exact). Retain the notation $\Theta_{B,\bullet},\Theta_{D,\bullet}$ for the transported morphisms. In $D(\operatorname{Tow}_{A_{Y'}})$ define
$$\Theta_{A,\bullet}=H^{-1}\Theta_{B,\bullet}\Phi_{Y'}(H),\qquad
\Theta_{C,\bullet}=(H')^{-1}\Theta_{D,\bullet}\Phi_{Y'}(H').$$
At finite level define the $P_n$-linear maps $\Theta_{A,n}=h_n^{-1}\Theta_{B,n}\Phi_{Y'}(h_n)$ and $\Theta_{C,n}=(h'_n)^{-1}\Theta_{D,n}\Phi_{Y'}(h'_n)$; their restrictions are the evaluations of these ambient strict structures. No quotient-diagram lift of the ambient $H,H'$ is needed for these definitions.
For $Z=A,B,C,D$ let $j_Z:\Phi_{Y'}R\lim Z_\bullet\to R\lim\Phi_{Y'}Z_\bullet$ be the canonical comparison obtained from [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison] for the inverse scheme automorphism $F_{Y'}^{-1}$, identifying its exact direct image with $\Phi_{Y'}$. Define
$$\Theta_{Z,\infty}=R\lim(\Theta_{Z,\bullet})j_Z.$$
Let $s_A:S\to A_\infty$ and $d:T\to D_\infty$ be precisely the two canonical comparisons in [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map], where $S=Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K$ and $T=Rf'_*L(g')^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$. Explicitly, $s_A$ is the first identification $S\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim A_\bullet$ in that definition, so its named map $s$ satisfies $s=R\lim(H)s_A$; and $d=c_{f',M}$ there, directed from $T$ to $D_\infty$. Define
$$\Theta_S=s_A^{-1}\Theta_{A,\infty}\Phi_{Y'}(s_A),\qquad
\Theta_T=d^{-1}\Theta_{D,\infty}\Phi_{Y'}(d).$$
All displayed $\Theta$ have source the Frobenius pullback of their target. On $S\otimes^LP_n$ and $T\otimes^LP_n$ use $\Theta_S\otimes1$ and $\Theta_T\otimes1$, with the natural pullback/tensor comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. This comparison is taken $P_n$-linearly, as the coefficient-reduction/pullback comparison $\chi$ of [def-weil-pbc-four-arrows], formed by the same formula for $F_{Y'}$ and its coefficient identifications $c_{F_{Y'}},c_{F_{Y'},n}$. These definitions specify the structures directly; they make no identification with the constant-$A$ level-map corners or chosen product-cone triples.

split_report.summary: Audited this definition against the current blueprint formulas and all sixteen original statement dependencies. Retained the actual quotient-coefficient categories, coherent diagram-site Weil datum, ambient projection-formula transports and total derived limit. Added explicit coefficient-datum, restriction-of-scalars and direct-image-evaluation references, and spelled out s_A and d in the completed-map normalization. No theorem proof or new node is needed. Removed two same_as entries that share formulas but use constant-coefficient level-map/product-cone objects rather than the actual quotient-coefficient strict towers. Reviewer fix (Q72 maintainer reader): cited lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections for the P_n-linear evaluation identifications of quotient-diagram derived operations and their compatibility with kappa, beta; recorded the resulting finite-level formulas for Theta_{B,n},Theta_{D,n}; made the P_n-linearity of the Theta_S, Theta_T reduction comparison explicit through chi of def-weil-pbc-four-arrows.
split_report.blueprint: lemma-weil-pbc-completed-map-reduction.proof.md, paragraph 4: the structures whose transport supplies the first and second Weil equations; realizes the corner formulas of def-weil-pbc-frobenius-corner-structures and the source/target conjugations of def-weil-pbc-completed-frobenius-structures directly in quotient coefficients.

tool_uses.why: Derives the specified module adjunction on arbitrary ringed diagram sites once both total derived functors exist; this generic adjunction tool does not replace the proper-base-change route.
Provides the canonical unbounded strict-tower comparison for the inverse scheme automorphism, which defines j_Z; this is a generic ringed-topos tool, independent of the unit proof route.

Supplies the P_n-linear evaluation identifications for derived pullback and direct image of strict semilinear (P_n)_T-systems (Q_T-modules on the diagram site), unbounded, with units, counits, pullback compositions and mates; no node of the proper-base-change unit states this for the varying quotient ring system.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q72-968b3f0e9 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the definition in full: every one of its 19 cited statements, the parent lemma's steps 8-14, and the main-20261015 blueprint (completed-map-reduction paragraph 4, frobenius-corner-structures, completed-frobenius-structures). Coefficient categories are right: quotient corners in D(Y',P_n) from four-corners/four-arrows, H and H' from the strict normalization lemma, all ambient towers in Tow_A. All Theta composites are well typed: Theta_B = g^*f_*(theta) g^*(beta_f) kappa_g, Theta_D = f'_*(theta_E) beta_f', and the transports by H^{-1}, s_A and d. They match the blueprint, where its t is the item's d^{-1}. The clarification s = Rlim(H) s_A is correct against completed-base-change-map. j_Z comes from the generic tower-limit comparison applied to F^{-1}, and its direction is correct. Passing from Q-coefficients to Delta A uses the pushforward-composition lemma and needs no flatness. Fault (C4/E5): the item put Theta_{B,n} and Theta_{D,n} in D(P_n) as evaluations, but its citations (direct-image-limits plus pushforward composition) give the evaluation identification only after restriction to A_T. Restriction from D(P_n) is not full, and ev_n need not preserve Q-K-injectives because P_n->P_k is not flat. The parent's step 10 also needs evaluation to carry kappa and beta to kappa_n and beta_n. Fix: I cited the reviewed lemma lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections (any small site, any strict ring system, unbounded, evaluations equal u^{-1} and Ru_{*,n} with units, counits, compositions and mates). It is off-unit, so I declared it as a tool use and checked that citing it makes no cycle. I also recorded the resulting finite-level formulas, which are the blueprint's, and stated why the restricted identifications agree with the ambient ones. Small fix: the Theta_S/Theta_T tensor comparison is now made P_n-linear through chi of def-weil-pbc-four-arrows. No new nodes, statement content and hypotheses unchanged, no SGA. I accept the tool uses lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors and lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison. Clearing same_as is accepted: those DAG nodes bind the same formulas to constant-Lambda level-map corners. Edge cases checked: identity Frobenius, a point with theta = multiplication by a unit, K=0, I=0.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer

lean.statement: def quotientCornerFrobeniusStructures [IsProper f] (hK : d.TowerComplete X K) (W : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteEtaleOriginWitness X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ((d.reduction X n).obj K)) : CornerStructures d F
lean.note: The coherent Weil datum lives on the actual ringed quotient sequence site. Ordinary constructions and their normalized universal-derived comparisons are retained; finite evaluation, completed-action restriction and total derived inverse limit are transported by those comparisons. All displayed corner structures are constructed, including finite conjugations and source/target tensor reductions. No target, dependency node or mathematical statement changed.
